name: First Tick
hint: The clock is running: the screen will not wait for you.
why4: The tunnel block needs four pushers, and the plate needs a pile of three while the fourth slips through the gate to hit the button.
solution: Timing: the screen scrolls 1 tile/s; its left edge reaches the tunnel (x=20) at t=20 s and the pile plate (x=40) at t=40 s, and the team can be at most 30 tiles ahead of it.
Everyone hops the bump at x=10-11 and jumps the 2-wide pit at x=14-15.
Conga in the tunnel: P1 against the block (x=20), P2, P3, P4 behind; all hold Right until the block drops into the hole at x=27-29 (6 tiles at 2.5 t/s = 2.4 s).
At the 1-wide pillar (x=40): P1 jumps onto the plate on top; P2 jumps from the floor onto P1's head; P3 hops onto the step at x=42-43 and jumps onto P2's head (3/3): gate A at x=48 opens.
P4 walks through gate A and touches the button at x=51 (hold 8 s); P4 keeps touching it.
P3, P2, P1 climb down and walk through the gate (9 tiles + dismount, about 2.5 s of the 8 s).
Everyone hops the 2-high step at x=56-57 and jumps the 3-wide pit at x=60-62, then waits for the screen to stop (left edge at x=66, t=66 s).

Final screen: the key sits on a 3-high shelf at x=74-76 (row 12) that the team walks under. P1 stands just left of it (x=73); P2 jumps off P1's head onto it, touches the key at x=75, jumps down on the far side. All jump the 2-wide pit at x=82-83; P2 opens the door at x=92; all press Down.
Recovery: a popped player drops back in above the teammate furthest behind.
